name: Signed-Ideal Homogeneous Polarization
statement: For $Q_C$ generated by the monomials of the minimally missing signed patterns of a nonempty finite class $C$, the paired differences $x_{i,0}-x_{i,1}$ form a regular sequence on $S_X/Q_C$ in some coordinate order. Equivalently they do so in every coordinate order, and $Q_C$ is a two-fold polarization of the Stanley--Reisner ideal of the shattered-support complex.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty binary class over an arbitrary coefficient field.
comments: The ideal does not include inconsistent literal-pair products. This criterion does not assert that $S_X/Q_C$ itself is Cohen--Macaulay.
